description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including GET endpoints with caching, ETag support, tenant resolution, and cache invalidation hooks. It handles listing, filtering, and retrieving session tracking data from a MongoDB model.

methods.name: roundToMinuteISO
methods.description: Rounds a date string to the start of the minute in ISO format for stable cache keys.

methods.name: cacheKeyFromReq
methods.description: Generates a deterministic cache key string based on request parameters and enforced tenant.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry if valid and not expired.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a cache entry with expiration and ETag.

methods.name: invalidateAllSessionTrackingCache
methods.description: Clears all cache entries related to session tracking GET requests.

methods.name: computeETag
methods.description: Computes a SHA-1 hash as an ETag based on response payload and context.

methods.name: sessionsEarlyBypassDetector
methods.description: Middleware to detect special tenant bypass conditions and set request flags accordingly.
